Company Introduction

 At Bot Auto, we are revolutionizing the transportation of goods with our cutting-edge autonomous trucks, enhancing the quality of life for communities around the globe. With the agility of a start-up and the wisdom of seasoned experts, Bot Auto boasts a team that has achieved numerous world-firsts and unparalleled innovations. United by a shared vision, we create miracles and propel the future of transportation. Join us and transform your dreams into reality.

 About the Role

 We are looking for an Onboard Infrastructure Engineer to join our Autonomous Driving team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the onboard infrastructure that supports autonomous vehicle systems, ensuring reliable communication, data management, and system integration. 

 You would work on critical infrastructure projects for autonomous driving systems, such as implementing middleware/ROS core functionalities, conducting optimizations to reduce latency and improving system determinism. You will play a critical role in designing and optimizing the architecture that handles real-time data from sensors and computing hardware. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of hardware, software, and real-world autonomous driving technology.

 Key Responsibilities

 
 Design and implement onboard infrastructure modules (sensor driver, health management) to support real-time autonomous driving applications, ensuring computing efficiency, and SW reliability in resource demanding environments.

 Monitor system performance and implement tools for diagnostics, logging, and recovery to ensure stable vehicle operations.

 Optimize the deployment of autonomous driving software to embedded systems and onboard computing platforms.

 
 Required Qualifications 

 
 Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of experience, or a Master’s degree with 2+ years of experience, in Computer Science or a related field.

 A strong willingness to develop computationally efficient code with consistently low runtime variance 

 Proficiency in C/C++ programming

 Write robust, reliable codes

 
 Preferred Qualifications 

 
 Experiences in Sensor SW development

 Experience with ROS (Robot Operating System) , or similar middleware for robotics and autonomous systems.

 3+ years of experience in onboard infrastructure, embedded systems, or systems engineering.

 Experience with autonomous driving technologies or similar high-performance computing systems

 Experience with RTOS ( Real-time Operating System )

 Experience with Nvidia Drive Products (Orin/Thor)
